entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The police confiscated everything...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You know, I lived here not long ago,[n]yet it feels almost like the distant[n]past at this point...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Being here has brought back memories[n]though. Whenever I acted out of line,[n]I was made to sit calmly in this corner.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ah, and over here was a bookshelf,[n]filled to the brim with various tomes.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It contained art compilation books for[n]the most part, but there were a few[n]manga tucked away as well...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: At times I would take a break from[n]my art to hide and read them...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This is also where we would gather[n]to eat when the atelier still had[n]a large pupil count.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Sensei is particularly[n]fond of salty food, so...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Sensei...? What am I saying?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Why do I still treat him as my[n]mentor? How long will I allow[n]him to control my life?
Are you okay?
You're not looking so good.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Y-Yes... My apologies.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: My apologies... I am merely a[n]little confused at the moment.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The truth of the matter is, I used to[n]paint in this room... and I did it simply[n]for the joy of painting.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: No matter what I took as my subject,[n]my hands would move of their own[n]accord to capture its essence...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But back then, I only saw the[n]superficial beauty of the world.[n]I could not see the grime beneath.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: After learning the truth behind[n]Madarame's actions though,[n]everything changed.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I strove to fight back against the[n]newfound ugliness I saw... To display[n]my talent to those who mocked me...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I needed to do whatever it took[n]to validate my artistic ability...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: In that search for meaning, darkness[n]took hold of me.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...Ultimately, I began to emulate[n]that which I had so deeply[n]despised in Madarame.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You know, Boss told me something[n]very interesting when I was staying[n]with you that one night at Leblanc...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: He said... he didn't believe Madarame[n]took me in for my skill alone.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I suppose now that I think about it,[n]there would be no way to know whether[n]or not I would have been talented.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...[fName], why do you think[n]Madarame decided to take me in?
Maybe he was sympathetic.
He somehow knew you had skill.
I couldn't possibly tell you.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm? So we return to matters[n]of the heart yet again...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It truly is a mysterious beast...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Yes, I agree.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Though... can that really be true?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: A fair point. That may be something only[n]Madarame himself is privy to...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Though perhaps even he doesn't know...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Even after learning the ugliness of his[n]true nature, a part of me still believes[n]in my former mentor.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I simply cannot come to terms with[n]the stark dualities presented to me...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The humble house and that loathsome[n]Palace... The kind teacher and the[n]fiendishly deceptive artist...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It seems even the workings of my own[n]heart are inexplicable... What, then of[n]my search for pure beauty?

entries.speaker: Man's Voice
entries.en: Hello?

entries.speaker: Man's Voice
entries.en: Is someone there? I'm coming in.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm? Could that be the police!?

entries.speaker: Old Gentleman
entries.en: Ah. I was wondering who[n]could have been in here...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You're... the man from the exhibition?

entries.speaker: Old Gentleman
entries.en: Indeed. Thank you for our[n]conversation back there.

entries.speaker: Old Gentleman
entries.en: More importantly though, why are you[n]here? I couldn't help but notice the door[n]was open on my way home from work.

entries.speaker: Old Gentleman
entries.en: Are you perhaps still caught in[n]your slump?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: How do you know about that?

entries.speaker: Old Gentleman
entries.en: I know a great deal about you,[n]Yusuke-kun.

entries.speaker: Old Gentleman
entries.en: You've made a name for yourself by[n]patterning your work after the [n]beautifully detailed "Sayuri"...

entries.speaker: Old Gentleman
entries.en: But that painting at the exhibition was...[n]quite different from that. Have you[n]begun trying out new styles?

entries.speaker: Old Gentleman
entries.en: If you'd like, I can advise you.

entries.speaker: Old Gentleman
entries.en: Materials, themes, et cetera.[n]You seem as though you could[n]use a helping hand right now.

entries.speaker: Old Gentleman
entries.en: Most of your painting was done while[n]living in this residence, correct?

entries.speaker: Old Gentleman
entries.en: Your current lack of patron must be[n]what is holding you back.

entries.speaker: Old Gentleman
entries.en: Please, take my card.

entries.speaker: Old Gentleman
entries.en: I've made a living investing in promising[n]young artists like yourself, Yusuke-kun.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Director of the Japanese Art Support[n]Foundation... Akio Kawanabe?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But... why have you chosen me?[n]You criticized me so harshly[n]back at the exhibition.

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: Because I feel you have talent.

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: Now, my foundation can provide you an[n]environment that will allow you to focus[n]on developing your skills.

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: If such a lifestyle interests you, we can[n]talk further at a later date.

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: As for today, I have business I must[n]attend to... but I hope to hear from[n]you soon.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The Japanese Art Support Foundation...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: My opportunity may have finally arrived...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: And it was all because you[n]opened that door for me...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm, it seems good luck is simply[n]a characteristic of yours.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You have my thanks, Leader.
I feel like my bond with Yusuke[n]is growing deeper...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...I must be going now. I'd like to think[n]on this some more.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Farewell.
